messages.text: Case CONT_DISPOSITIONS. Here are my decisions on the six issues: reject the betrayal idea; revise the harbour rescue proposal to one in the morning, after arrival; deliberately revise canon so Rúna learned the rescue code before the ship sank, retaining the previous version; revise the destruction idea so a different unusable boat is destroyed and the only usable escape boat remains intact; the crossing letter is intentionally an unreliable witness’s false account, not an event in author truth, so preserve the boundary rule; defer the shared-childhood relationship issue without settling either alternative. Separately, perhaps the recorded brass seal could foreshadow the sender. The time Freyja learned the hidden-room secret is unknown. The reader may see the letter after its delivery even though Rúna saw it earlier. Rúna might lie that she, rather than Bjarni, sent it; this is possible dialogue only. Explore these safe possibilities briefly, summarize the checkpoint I request now, and pause.

Your six dispositions are recorded with their prior versions retained.

1. Betrayal rejected (ca37ee5a r2; decision 6b8f2dc8 r1); finding 336c0a14 r2 is rejected_idea. Rúna’s oath remains unchanged (249f979b r1).

2. Rescue revised to one in the morning, explicitly after arrival, and remains proposed (69b1fceb r2; event a59cef3c r2; decision 602d93fa r1). Finding 42774683 r2 is revised_idea.

3. Canon revised: Rúna learned the code before the sinking (89357784 r1; author truth a153fa04 r1; character knowledge 39fc465b r1; decision b00f3432 r1). Prior learning e7860735 r1 and knowledge 82dc2970 r1 / da98ac0d r1 remain inspectable; their current versions are superseded. Finding d0614c62 r2 is revised_canon. The code-use prevention proposal (fe6fa08b r1) is still unaccepted; no successful prevention or erasure of the recorded sinking has been established.

4. Destruction revised to a different unusable boat, with the only usable escape boat intact within that proposal (bfef12dd r2; distinct boat 7063c495 r1; decision 06d97456 r1). Finding 04d94072 r2 is revised_idea. The revised destruction remains proposed.

5. The apparent crossing is now an intentional unreliable witness’s false account (82980897 r1; false-account assertion 1251fe58 r1; technique decision 1f6f5c8d r1). Finding c8bed026 r2 is intentional (resolution a4acd395 r1). The original crossing proposal is superseded; the boundary rule remains unchanged (d148a2a0 r1). No witness belief or true crossing has been inferred.

6. Shared childhood is deferred and unresolved (42cd4d30 r2; finding 69b768af r2; decision f7b15a21 r1). Its significant hold remains on the same affected relationship and reunion scope. The never-met fact (20ec7fd0 r1) remains unchanged; neither alternative has been settled by this deferral.

Brief safe exploration:

- The brass seal can become a clue readers reinterpret after Bjarni’s authorship is revealed, without choosing a seal-to-sender mechanism or inventing seal ownership (ef0b727a r1; advisory opportunity cefb035a r1; established seal 8913530c r1 and sender bd51f70d r1).
- Freyja’s secret-learning time remains unknown, with null chronological bounds. That is not proof she knew it before any event, nor proof she did not (2619c8e9 r1; open question acc2c929 r1).
- A delayed reader view can coexist with Rúna having seen the letter earlier: reader presentation order is separate from character knowledge and story chronology. No exact earlier clock time is inferred (e5c3a12c r1; reader revelation d45aee58 r1; character perspective 03ddca22 r1).
- Rúna’s possible lie could misdirect the reader without changing Bjarni’s established authorship. It remains proposed dialogue, not a confession or a new sender fact (cf68a5b3 r1).

Checkpoint summary: exchange a24f43cb-db0a-42b6-af10-147502f98ae0, sequence 14; predecessor Git checkpoint da8f19d1dbefd271a7d2abebfa41ea599dc97ca4 (sequence 13). References identify the supporting record revisions.

The shared-childhood conflict remains deferred with its promotion hold (69b768af r2). The earlier floating-bridge timing/intent uncertainty remains open (c8ddb813 r1). The foreshadowing opportunity is advisory and non-blocking (cefb035a r1). The old question “Why did Rúna send the letter?” still has an outdated premise after the sender revision and remains open for your review (f1e737c0 r1). No other open question has been answered.

- The recorded brass seal could foreshadow the sender. (ef0b727a r1; proposed).

Open and unanswered questions:

- Why did Rúna send the letter? (f1e737c0 r1).
- What does Edda want from Bjarni? (55b62a7f r1).
- Who finds the letter? (d7c22da4 r1).
- When does Bjarni return? (f68c6800 r1).
- What opens the hidden room? (e7236c19 r1).
- What if Ari has a daughter? (73f2747c r1).
- Could the boat have a leak? (3c94b6c2 r1).
- For the hidden-room entrance, does “Yes” select the floor hatch, the wall door, or neither yet? (bffb6141 r1).
- When did Freyja learn the hidden-room secret? (acc2c929 r1).

Paused here until your next direction.
